generic_repository_rule: A repository-only discovery record has no task key and is not collapsed with a later task-level record from the same repository.
identity_collision_rule: Retain one candidate ID from the highest-priority provenance, attach every lower-priority source position and hash, and never discard provenance.
id_exhaustion_rule: Stop before import and amend prospectively; do not spill into another source range.
source_priority_rationale: Priority resolves duplicate identifiers by evidentiary specificity only; it cannot score, include, exclude, or select a candidate.
